subject: TAXONOMY (operator-raised 2026-07-31): 'if it is a lab it cannot be a project and vice versa'. The Cloud Master capstone is a LAB by every piece of data -- lives in houses/cloud/openstack/labs/, named .lab.html, typed components:['lab'] -- and was hand-registered onto the hub's PROJECTS shelf for prominence via functions/register-capstone-project.js. That is the root cause of the double-render; the de-dup fix only picks a winner and picks the WRONG one (curated-wins keeps the mislabelled Projects card and drops the honest Labs card). STRUCTURAL FINDING: components:['project'] appears 0 times in the whole catalog (vs 1003 'lab'), so BUCKET.project can never fire and EVERY hub's Projects shelf is dead unless hand-written. PLAN: (1) remove the Firestore sections.projects entry so it shows once under Labs and the Projects shelf reads 0, which is true; (2) build P2 'Survive the Drift' (cloud-openstack-iac-harden, already designed in ProjectsData, hasPage:false) as a real project; (3) decide whether real projects get typed components:['project'] so the shelf self-populates, or stays curation-only and is documented. REJECTED: promoting the capstone into /projects/ -- renames a LIVE url, high-risk for bookmarks and progress keys.
